say:1:1035806001:1.text: Some are outside of the Sun Temple like me, waiting on supplies and reinforcements.
say:1:1035806001:1.source_cn: 有一些和我一样，在日神殿的外侧，随时准备补给和增援。
say:1:1035806001:1.male: Some are outside of the Sun Temple like me, waiting on supplies and reinforcements.
say:1:1035806001:1.female: Some are outside of the Sun Temple like me, waiting on supplies and reinforcements.

say:2:1035806002:1.text: The strongest acolytes are all inside the Sun Temple, handling the most dangerous tasks.
say:2:1035806002:1.source_cn: 最有能力的修士都在日神殿里，处理最危险也最要紧的问题。
say:2:1035806002:1.male: The strongest acolytes are all inside the Sun Temple, handling the most dangerous tasks.
say:2:1035806002:1.female: The strongest acolytes are all inside the Sun Temple, handling the most dangerous tasks.
